title: Virtual Card Management: Team-Based Spending Controls and Limits
summary: This document explains how to set up Virtual Card Management team groups (up to 30), configure team-based per-card policies in **Teams & Limits**, and apply a default per-card cap up to **$150,000** that new cards inherit. It also covers how to override limits for exceptions without changing the team baseline and how to periodically review and adjust caps (while not exceeding $150,000), with guidance to limit overrides for reporting across all groups.
faqs: How do I create and manage team groups for virtual card policies, and what is the maximum number of groups?
Where in the system do I set team-based controls, and how are default per-card policies applied to newly issued cards?
What is the standard per-card cap I can set for a team, and what is the maximum allowed amount?
How do I override the default per-card limit for an individual card while keeping the team’s baseline policy intact?
How often should I review and adjust each team’s spend profile, and are there any limits on how high the cap can be?
What governance practices does the document recommend for team naming and limiting exception overrides?
